projects.name: music-metadata
projects.description: extracts tags, cover art, duration, and technical audio information from formats including MP3, FLAC, MP4, Ogg, and WAV. It works with files and streams in Node.js and browser applications, giving developers one API across different formats and data sources.

feature.heading: Read audio metadata across formats and environments
feature.outcome: Choose an audio file in the Audio Tag Analyzer to inspect its metadata and artwork directly in your browser. Your file stays on your device.

projects.name: strtok3
projects.description: provides a shared way to read binary data. With @tokenizer/http and @tokenizer/s3, parsers can read selected portions of remote files using range requests.

feature.heading: Read the parts of a remote file that matter
feature.outcome: Metadata parsing and file detection can skip data they do not need to read. When the source supports range requests, this can reduce data transfer compared with downloading the entire file.

projects.name: file-type
projects.description: identifies file formats from their contents. I help maintain this library, which uses the same tokenizer infrastructure and connects this work to applications beyond audio.

feature.heading: Improve file detection in the wider ecosystem
feature.outcome: My file-type extensions add detection for audio and video, compound documents, PDF-based formats, and XML-based formats. I also contribute to is-svg.
feature.statsDetail: Shown separately from my package total
